sections.text:
《Antiviral actions of interferons》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Tremendous progress has been made in understanding the molecular basis of the antiviral actions of interferons (IFNs), as well as strategies evolved by viruses to antagonize the actions of IFNs.
